reason: Check backend security contracts, denial tests, risk summary stability/sanitization, and test fixture naming.
Check paired SQLite/PostgreSQL migrations, safe defaults, indexes, and rollback safety.
Check scope enforcement and audit failures return sanitized, fail-closed errors.
Check no credential-use event, log, or error contains private keys, passwords, tokens, decrypted executor config, terminal streams, or unsafe command output.
Check frontend API mappers and UI use camelCase domain data with safe fallbacks.
Check frontend tests, loading/error states, i18n, and npm run check readiness.
Check new Settings/audit UI accessibility and icon labeling.
Check DB/model/API/frontend contract consistency and boundary validation.
Check SSH key scope and credential audit helpers are reused across paths rather than duplicated.
Check implementation follows the chosen metadata, permissive migration defaults, and enforcement boundary recommendations.
Check implementation uses a secret-safe dedicated credential-use audit model and covers the P1 core event set.
Check P1 builds on the P0 surfaces and does not regress prior hardening behavior.
